theme_and_archetype.description: Tasteful, editorial, minimal, premium but understated. A warm and approachable driving school that feels like a Swiss premium design studio built it.

typography.rules: No Clash Display or Inter for headings. Use Fraunces for a warm, editorial, premium feel. Manrope for clean, highly legible body text.

spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for pills/buttons
spacing_and_layout.whitespace: Generous. Allow elements to breathe. Do not cramp content. Follow Swiss grid principles.

components.buttons: Refined pill shape (rounded-full). Primary: bg-emerald-800 text-white hover:bg-emerald-900. Secondary: border border-stone-300 text-stone-900 hover:border-stone-400 bg-transparent. Subtle transition duration-300.
components.cards: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300. No aggressive hovers.
components.forms: Minimal editorial forms. Underline inputs only (border-b border-stone-300 bg-transparent rounded-none px-0). No heavy box shadows on inputs.
components.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) with a 1px bottom border (border-stone-200). Refined and minimal.

animation.philosophy: Much lighter touch. Subtle fade-in and slide-up on scroll using framer-motion. No rotating blobs, no rotating cards.
animation.hover_states: Subtle border/color shifts, maybe a 1px translate-y on cards or button shadows. Keep it elegant.

image_urls.description: Scenic empty road driving, soft lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Discard the previous bold/dynamic design completely.
Implement a refined, minimal, and warm editorial design using the Stone and Emerald color palette.
Use Fraunces for all headings, and Manrope for body text.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Implement the following sections: Hero, Über mich (Nadine), Services (6 cards), Fleet (3 cars), Pricing (4 plans), Gallery, Testimonials, Contact form.
Build a DE/EN switcher in the header.
Keep animations strictly to subtle framer-motion fades (e.g. initial={opacity: 0, y: 20} whileInView={opacity: 1, y: 0}). No floating blobs.
